import ast,base64,hashlib,json,struct,zlib
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
root=Path.cwd()
r=json.loads((root/"coordinacion/respuestas/PRECISION-OBLIQUE-TOTAL-PHASE-READBACK-HOST-001-CODEX.json").read_bytes())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for path,h in r["code_doc_sha256"].items():
    p=Path(path);assert sha((p if p.is_absolute()else root/p).read_bytes())==h,path
def cap(t):
    raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(t["stdout_zlib_base64"],validate=True))
    assert t["rc"]==0 and t["timed_out"]is False and len(raw)==t["stdout_bytes"] and sha(raw)==t["stdout_sha256"]
    return json.loads(raw)
d=cap(r["test_run"])["data"]
p=json.loads((root/r["parents"]["candidate"]["path"]).read_bytes());parent=cap(p["test_run"])["data"]
n=json.loads((root/r["parents"]["native"]["path"]).read_bytes());native=cap(n["test_run"])["data"]
byid={q["id"]:q["result"]for q in native["runs"]};prep={q["id"]:q["result"]for q in parent["preparations"]}
assert len(d["runs"])==154 and len({x["id"]for x in d["runs"]})==154
assert sum(x["result"]["status"]=="HOST_UNATTESTED_TOTAL_PHASE_MATCH"for x in d["runs"])==11
assert d["compiler_calls"]==0 and d["RN64_operations"]==0 and d["producer_replays"]==0 and not d["GPU_executed"]
def rat(h):
    bits=int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(h),"little")
    sign=-1 if bits&(1<<63)else 1;exp=(bits>>52)&2047;assert exp!=2047
    frac=bits&((1<<52)-1)
    return sign*(F(1)+F(frac,1<<52))*F(2)**(exp-1023)if exp else sign*F(frac,1<<52)*F(2)**(-1022)
def frac(p):return F(p[0],p[1])
def pair(v):return [v.numerator,v.denominator]
def digest(q):return sha(json.dumps(q,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False).encode())
def packet(q):return zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(q["zlib_base64"]))
mutcounts={};matched=0
for q in d["runs"]:
    case=q["case"];result=q["result"];id=q["id"];old=byid[case]
    assert result["promotion"]=="STOP" and result["full_costs"]=="UNMEASURED_NOT_ZERO"
    assert all(result[k]is False for k in("GPU_executed","GPU_launch_allowed","GPU_guard_certified","device_egress_authenticated",
        "fence_readback_authenticated","scene_authenticated","material_authenticated","native_promotion_allowed","physical_field_certified"))
    assert all(result[k]==0 for k in("RN64_operations","producer_replays","compiler_calls"))
    if result["status"]=="STOP":assert result["rows"]==[] and result["verified_rows"]==0 and result["output_sha256"]is None
    if id.startswith("sealed:")and old["status"]=="STOP":
        assert result["reason"].startswith("parent_STOP:") and result["decoded_components"]==0;continue
    expected_input=packet(prep[case]["input"]);expected_output=packet(prep[case]["expected_output"])
    rows=old["rows"];registry=native["registry"][case]
    words=[v[k]["word_le_hex"]for v in registry["fixture"]["rows"][:2]for k in("hi","lo")]+[v[k]for v in old["encodings"]for k in("hi","lo")]
    assert expected_input==struct.pack("<4I",0x54504731,10,2,1)+b"".join(bytes.fromhex(h)for h in words)
    assert expected_output==struct.pack("<4I",0x54504731,6,2,1)+b"".join(bytes.fromhex(v[k])for v in rows for k in("hi","lo"))
    if id.startswith("sealed:"):
        rq=q["request"];request=registry["request"];nr=next(x["request"]for x in native["runs"]if x["id"]==case)
        assert set(rq)=={"case","compiler_receipt_sha256","input_sha256","SPIRV_sha256","original_scene_sha256","literal_request_sha256",
            "phase_request_sha256","native_selector_sha256","abi_tag","intent"}
        assert rq["compiler_receipt_sha256"]==r["parents"]["candidate"]["sha256"] and rq["input_sha256"]==sha(expected_input)
        assert rq["SPIRV_sha256"]==parent["valid_compile"]["spirv"]["sha256"]
        assert rq["original_scene_sha256"]==request["original_scene_sha256"] and rq["literal_request_sha256"]==request["literal_request_sha256"]
        assert rq["phase_request_sha256"]==digest(request) and rq["native_selector_sha256"]==digest(nr)
        assert rq["abi_tag"]==0x54504731 and rq["intent"]=="HOST_TOTAL_PHASE_READBACK_NUMERIC_ONLY"
    if result["decoded_components"]:
        assert result["decoded_components"]==6 and q["input_hex"]==expected_input.hex()
        raw=bytes.fromhex(q["output_hex"]);ww=[raw[16+8*i:24+8*i].hex()for i in range(6)]
        vals=[rat(ww[2*i])+rat(ww[2*i+1])for i in range(3)];delta=[];computed=[]
        for i in range(2):
            row=rows[i];lo,hi=map(frac,row["interval_cycles"]);dd=abs(vals[i]-frac(row["value_cycles"]));delta.append(dd)
            bound=frac(row["conservative_error_rad"])+8*dd;direct=8*max(abs(vals[i]-lo),abs(vals[i]-hi));limit=frac(row["literal_cap_rad"])
            assert direct<=bound
            computed.append((row["record_id"],pair(vals[i]),pair(bound),pair(direct),pair(limit),bound<=limit))
        row=rows[2];lo,hi=map(frac,row["interval_cycles"]);err=abs(vals[2]-(vals[0]-vals[1]))
        b=8*(frac(row["geometric_error_cycles"])+frac(row["gamma_radius_cycles"])+frac(row["gamma_encoding_error_cycles"])+
            frac(row["SOURCE_add_error_cycles"])+sum(delta)+err)
        direct=8*max(abs(vals[2]-lo),abs(vals[2]-hi));limit=frac(row["literal_cap_rad"]);assert direct<=b
        computed.append((row["record_id"],pair(vals[2]),pair(b),pair(direct),pair(limit),b<=limit))
        diag=result["diagnostics"];assert len(diag)==3
        for observed,actual in zip(diag,computed):
            assert (observed["record_id"],observed["value_cycles"],observed["conservative_error_rad"],observed["direct_error_rad"],
                observed["literal_cap_rad"],observed["fits"])==actual
        if result["status"]=="HOST_UNATTESTED_TOTAL_PHASE_MATCH":
            assert all(v["fits"]for v in diag) and raw==expected_output and result["rows"]==diag and result["verified_rows"]==3
            assert result["output_sha256"]==sha(raw);matched+=1
        elif result["reason"]=="native_TOTAL_phase_bits":assert all(v["fits"]for v in diag) and raw!=expected_output
        elif result["reason"]=="ALL_SOURCE_readback_cap":assert not all(v["fits"]for v in diag[:2])
        elif result["reason"]=="relative_readback_cap":assert all(v["fits"]for v in diag[:2]) and not diag[2]["fits"]
        else:assert False,result["reason"]
    if id.startswith("output_nonfinite:")or id.startswith("input_nonfinite:"):
        side=id.split(":")[0];i=int(id.split(":")[1]);raw=bytes.fromhex(q["output_hex"]if side=="output_nonfinite"else q["input_hex"])
        ex=(int.from_bytes(raw[16+8*i:24+8*i],"little")>>52)&2047;assert ex==2047
        assert result["decoded_components"]==0 and result["reason"]=="raw_nonfinite_"+("6"if side=="output_nonfinite"else "10")
        group="output_nonfinite"if side=="output_nonfinite"else "input_nonfinite";mutcounts[group]=mutcounts.get(group,0)+1
    if id.startswith("within_cap_wrong_bits:"):
        i=int(id.rsplit(":",1)[1]);raw=bytes.fromhex(q["output_hex"]);newbits=int.from_bytes(raw[16+8*i:24+8*i],"little")
        oldbits=int.from_bytes(expected_output[16+8*i:24+8*i],"little");assert newbits==oldbits+1
        assert result["reason"]=="native_TOTAL_phase_bits" and all(v["fits"]for v in result["diagnostics"])
        mutcounts["within_cap"]=mutcounts.get("within_cap",0)+1
    if id=="same_delta_both_SOURCE_relative_value_unchanged":
        raw=bytes.fromhex(q["output_hex"]);assert raw[48:]==expected_output[48:]
        src=lambda b,j:rat(b[16+16*j:24+16*j].hex())+rat(b[24+16*j:32+16*j].hex())
        dx=[src(raw,j)-src(expected_output,j)for j in range(2)]
        assert dx[0]==dx[1]!=0 and result["reason"]=="ALL_SOURCE_readback_cap"
    if id=="stale_finite_input":assert result["reason"]=="sealed_input_bits_before_decode" and result["decoded_components"]==0 and q["input_hex"]!=expected_input.hex()
assert matched==11 and mutcounts=={"output_nonfinite":24,"input_nonfinite":10,"within_cap":33}
assert sum(x["id"].startswith("sealed:")for x in d["runs"])==46
assert all(x["result"]["status"]=="STOP"for x in d["runs"]if not x["id"].startswith("sealed:"))
core=root/"Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/oblique_total_phase_readback_HOST_v1.py"
tree=ast.parse(core.read_text(encoding="utf8"));fn=next(x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef)and x.name=="compare")
assert [a.arg for a in fn.args.args]==["model","request","input_bytes","output_bytes","origin"]
text=core.read_text(encoding="utf8")
assert text.index('words=raw_guard(output_bytes,6,64)')<text.index('values=[number(w)')
assert text.index('need(all(v["fits"]for v in pending[:2])')<text.index('need(output_bytes==a["output"]')
ast.parse((root/"Blender/tests/test_oblique_total_phase_readback_HOST.py").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
print(json.dumps(dict(status="PASS",runs=154,matches=11,parent_STOP=35,new_STOP=108,raw_output_nonfinite=24,
    raw_input_nonfinite=10,within_cap_wrong_bits=33,ALL_SOURCE_translation_STOP=1,pins=len(r["code_doc_sha256"]),
    compiler_calls=0,RN64_operations=0,GPU_launch_allowed=False)))
